slides.title: Async & Await Basics
slides.prompt: Asyncio provides cooperative multitasking using event loops and coroutines.
slides.codeSnippet:
import asyncio

async def fetch_data():
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    return "Data"

asyncio.run(fetch_data())
